notes.title: Voice of NBA Jam is Joining Joltzsi! BOOMSHAKALAKA!
notes.notes:
[b]BOOMSHAKALAKA![/b]

The voice of NBA Jam, NFL Blitz and Mutant Football League will be featured in Joltzsi, continuing our love of arcade action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618363/5ee101563df8d6915ca877c3dcf3d45e0269b990.png[/img]

[b]On Fire Edition[/b]

In addition to being part of the base game, will be a downloadable "On Fire Edition!" with unique bonus rules for the game and a series of unique, hilariously lines by the voice of the arcade!

What an honor to work with the voice of my childhood!
